text:
eva: hey team — customer reporting rerank endpoint returning weird scores and a 422 when they follow the Console cURL snippet in our docs. they pasted the exact body from the console, `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"best hotels","documents":["a","b"]}'` and get `422 Unprocessable Entity: invalid payload`

ryan: can you ask for the full request body and the exact error payload? 422 suggests schema mismatch. also which region/plan? sometimes dedicated vs hosted differences in validation.

eva: customer provided this verbatim:
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX
Content-Type: application/json

{"query":"best hotels","documents":["inn by the bay","mountain view resort"]}
```
Error response: `{"error":"invalid_request","message":"expected field 'queries' (array) but got string 'query'"}`

mika: aha — i'm pretty sure our rerank schema expects `queries` (array of query objects) and `items` or `candidates` depending on model. docs console snippet shows the older single-query shorthand (`query` + `documents`) which we left for the Console quick demo, but the API server validates strictly and only accepts the explicit arrays on the latest runtime. that mismatch will cause 422.

eva: customer also says scores are weird when they do manage to get past the schema — they get identical scores for each candidate (all 0.5) even though content differs.

mika: identical scores often mean tokenization/encoding issue — if we accidentally pass `Content-Type: text/plain` or forget to escape newlines the server might treat the document array as a single concatenated string. also some older SDKs batch and send `documents` as newline-delimited values which our reranker treats as one item. can you get the raw HTTP payload byte-by-byte?

ryan: asked for full HAR, customer attached host-level logs showing Content-Type header set to `application/json` but they were invoking cURL from Windows shell using single quotes — Windows cmd doesn't honor single quotes so the payload arrived literally with the single quotes included which made JSON invalid on our end. their HAR shows body: `'{'query':'best hotels','documents':['a','b']}'` (single quotes) -> server returned 400 parsing error previously but new runtime converted to 422.

nate: sounds like two separate doc problems: (1) Console cURL sample uses single-quote JSON which breaks on PowerShell/Windows; (2) quick shorthand `query` + `documents` example is out-of-sync with current API schema that requires arrays (`queries` + `items`). i'll open a docs PR to add both bash and PowerShell examples and clarify schema.

eva: customer also hit a `413 Payload Too Large` when they tried sending long doc arrays in a single request (500+ items). docs don't clearly call out the per-request candidate limit.

mika: current limits: hosted rerank accepts up to 200 candidates per query; Dedicated may be higher depending on config. we should add that to the rerank page and include guidance to chunk and stream. also we should surface a clear error message when limit exceeded (currently 413 with no body).

ryan: quick repro steps we used:
1) failing cURL (Windows):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"pizza","documents":["pizzeria a","pizzeria b"]}'
```
-> arrives malformed because Windows removed the backslashes and single quotes got included.

2) working cURL (bash & Windows-safe PowerShell):
Bash:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries":[{"query":"pizza"}],"items":[{"id":"a","text":"pizzeria a"},{"id":"b","text":"pizzeria b"}]}'
```
PowerShell (escape double quotes):
```
$body = '{"queries":[{"query":"pizza"}],"items":[{"id":"a","text":"pizzeria a"},{"id":"b","text":"pizzeria b"}]}'
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -Body $body
```

mika: also add example for SDK users: python snippet that uses the `rerank` client which handles escaping and batching.

eva: customer attached a failing response showing `scores` array length equals number of candidates but all identical; they also uploaded a tokenized dump where both docs normalized to the same token sequence because their client side lowercased and removed punctuation incorrectly. so there were two root causes: docs/cURL causing malformed JSON; client preprocessing collapsing documents; and API/validation differences.

ryan: created support ticket #12345 and asked customer to try the provided PowerShell snippet. asked them to send HAR if still broken.

mika: engineering follow-ups:
- add clearer validation errors for schema mismatch: e.g., "expected 'queries' array: use queries=[{query:...}] instead of query:"
- return an explicit JSON body on 413 listing the candidate limit
- detect identical-score pathological cases and log warning `candidate_normalization_collapsed` to help debug
- add server-side tolerance for the old shorthand for one-off backwards-compatibility with a deprecation header for 6 months

nate: docs follow-ups:
- update rerank quickstart with bash and PowerShell cURL examples (done: PR #4012)
- add per-request candidate limit section and chunking guidance
- add note about escaping and Windows pitfalls
- add sample HAR and troubleshooting checklist for support engineers

deploy-bot: deployment queued for docs PR #4012 to staging docs site — ETA 2 hours

eva: i'll share the working PowerShell snippet with the customer and confirm. if they still see weird scores i'll escalate to mika with HAR + token dumps.

ryan: closing loop: summary for ticket #12345 -> primary cause: docs cURL sample used unsupported shorthand and single-quote style that broke JSON on Windows; secondary cause: customer preprocessing collapsed doc tokens which led to uniform scores; mitigations: docs update, server validation improvements, and a support KB entry.

mika: i'll schedule a short patch to return clearer validation messages and a deprecation notice for the shorthand. pls ping if you want me to prioritize the 413 JSON body change.

eva: thanks all, i will update the ticket and set a reminder to check back after docs deploy. :thumbsup:
